name: vampi
notes: UNVERIFIED in this build environment — no network to pull/run the image here; all values (port 5000, health path '/', /createdb seed, env toggles) come from VAmPI's public docs and must be verified on first launch. Canonical image: Docker Hub `erev0s/vampi` (source: github.com/erev0s/VAmPI), a small Flask REST API returning JSON. DB SETUP: the SQLite DB is empty on boot — the harness must GET /createdb (seed_path) to populate users/books before auditing, or endpoints return empty/errors. VULN TOGGLE: env `vulnerable=1` enables the intentionally vulnerable code paths (notably the raw string-concatenated username lookup); `tokentimetolive` sets JWT TTL. AUTH: POST /users/v1/register and /users/v1/login (JSON bodies) mint a JWT, and most write endpoints require the Authorization token — so an unauthenticated scan only covers the unauth surface; both curated findings below are reachable unauthenticated. INSERTION: the SQLi lives in a URL path segment (the <username>), so URL_PATH_SEG is required to hit it; JSON_VALUE covers the register/login bodies; timing is not essential (the SQLi is error/response-based), so drop_timing is on. CURATED LABELS ARE OUR CURATION (co-design caveat): a deliberately minimal, DAST-detectable subset of VAmPI's documented issues — (1) SQLi at GET /users/v1/{username} (unsanitized string-concatenated SQL when vulnerable=1; verified in models/user_model.py get_user) and (2) excessive-data-exposure at GET /users/v1/_debug (dumps every user including plaintext passwords; verified in get_all_users_debug). Both endpoints are unauthenticated (verified in api_views/users.py — no token check). Both are stable and well-documented but should be re-verified against the running build. Other documented VAmPI issues (BOLA on /books/v1/{title}, mass assignment / admin escalation on register, unauthorized password change on /users/v1/{username}/password, weak-JWT broken auth) are intentionally omitted because they are stateful/logic bugs not reliably discoverable by an injection/crawl DAST and would distort recall scoring. REVIEW VERDICT: image canonical, port/health-path correct, curated locations verified against source and reachable unauthenticated, bug_class labels ('sqli','exposure') are valid CRUCIBLE vocabulary, heavy=false correct (not owasp-benchmark/gitlab-ce/mattermost). No corrections needed.
